name: Baked Oatmeal
summary: Oats baked with banana, egg, and milk into squares. Make once, eat all week.
instructions: Heat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mashed banana, peanut butter, syrup, cinnamon, and baking powder together.
Stir in the oats until evenly mixed. Pour into the dish.
Bake 35 minutes, until set and golden on top.
Cool slightly, cut into four squares, and serve. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

glutenFree.notes: Oats are naturally gluten-free but are often processed alongside wheat — use certified gluten-free oats if cross-contamination is a concern.

budgetNotes: Bake on Sunday and reheat squares through the week.
Overripe bananas are cheaper and sweeter — perfect here.
Swap the peanut butter for a handful of frozen berries if you prefer.
